|translation='''Title:''' Fall back!

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent declares a battle at an exterior location where the opponent's total power is more than double yours. Use 1 Force to cancel the battle and move all of your characters there to an adjacent location where the opponent has no presence.

'''Lore:'''
"To K-10, all troops abandon the mission."
